acme_prod: Hey @jess_support — starting ~08:10 UTC we're seeing a huge spike in 504s from the hosted inference API for our nightly embed batch. ~15-25% of requests are timing out. SDK v1.4.2, region: us-west1. Happening only for our large batches (~400 items, avg payload ~50KB).

acme_prod: Minimal repro steps: use the JS SDK batchEmbed with `batchSize: 400`, `timeoutMs: 120000` — works occasionally, but often returns 504. Example call id from today: `req_20240315_8a9c`.

jess_support: Thanks — sorry about this. Can you paste a raw failing request ID + any client-side error logs? Also, are you seeing retries from the SDK?

acme_prod: Pasting client log snippet: ````
[2024-03-15T08:11:04.123Z] request=req_20240315_8a9c status=504 message="gateway timeout" attempt=1
[2024-03-15T08:11:05.200Z] request=req_20240315_8a9c status=504 message="gateway timeout" attempt=2
````
We see the SDK doing immediate retries (default backoff).

jess_support: Ok. Two quick mitigation suggestions while we investigate: 1) reduce client concurrency to avoid bursting the edge (try `concurrency: 4` or smaller), 2) increase per-request `timeoutMs` to 180000 if you can tolerate it. Could you also run one reproducible curl that fails for us? Example: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d @payload.json` and paste the `X-Request-Id` from the response headers if present.

acme_prod: I ran a curl and got `HTTP/1.1 504` and header `x-request-id: rwd-9f2b1c`. Pasted.

ryan_sre: @jess_support I'm seeing an uptick of latency and `502/504` on the us-west1 ingress at ~08:09-08:20 UTC. Correlates with several large embed batches. Initial hypothesis: edge upstreams hitting a per-connection window and causing slowwrites into the runtime pool.

ryan_sre: Can you ask the customer to temporarily switch to smaller batches (e.g., 50-100) while we triage? That will avoid saturating the request-coalescer.

natalie_eng: Adding some datapoints from runtime: noticed many long-tailed KV cache locks when sequence lengths are large and parallel requests touch similar keys. That increases per-request latency and contributes to gateway timeouts. Might be contention in our prefix cache when lots of similar prompt segments get deduped.

natalie_eng: Running a triage plan: 1) capture edge logs for `x-request-id: rwd-9f2b1c` and surrounding minute; 2) pull runtime tail for matching `req_*` traces; 3) check autoscaler events for any transient scale failures.

deploy-bot: Deploy note: no recent runtime deploys between 07:30-08:30 UTC. Canary 2024-03-15-07:00 passed. :white_check_mark:

jess_support: Thanks. @acme_prod — can you try one small test: set `batchSize: 80` and `concurrency: 2` and run the same job. If that clears the 504s, we can recommend a short-term config change. Also, we've disabled immediate SDK auto-retry for your job so you don't amplify the queue (we asked you not to retry too fast).

acme_prod: Will try now. Quick question: will reducing batchSize hurt cost significantly? Not much, we can absorb a little extra overhead.

sam_billing: FYI — if they break the job into more calls it could increase token counts slightly due to duplicated context, but should be marginal compared to failure/retry churn.

acme_prod: Ran with `batchSize: 80` and `concurrency: 2` — so far no 504s in the last 6 minutes. Thanks.

ryan_sre: Great — looks like burst/concurrency was the immediate trigger. We'll keep digging to remove KV cache contention. Natalie, can you check whether we can add a short-term lock timeout/queue slot increase on runtime to reduce head-of-line blocking?

natalie_eng: On it. Quick patch options: bump small-request worker pool sizes for us-west1 or introduce fine-grained KV lock sharding for large payloads. I'll prototype a config flip to increase worker pool by 20% for queuing windows.

jess_support: I'll mark this as active and keep the customer posted. Summary to customer: temporary mitigation = reduce batchSize & concurrency (they reported success). We're investigating root cause (KV cache contention + edge backpressure) and will follow up with timeline.

acme_prod: Appreciate the fast help — please keep us posted. Any ETA on a permanent fix?

natalie_eng: Goal: we should have an internal PR + canary config by EOD UTC and a rollback-safe rollout. If canary looks good, we can push a broader config change early next week. Not a full code change unless we go with sharding, which will take longer.

ryan_sre: Also adding an internal playbook note: advise reducing large embed batch sizes for now and avoid immediate retries. We'll follow up with a postmortem if this reoccurs. :memo:

jess_support: I'll keep this thread updated. Closing loop: change status = investigating -> monitoring. :eyes:
